The next thing was for it to add additional functionality, it applied it, it broke something, I went back, it fixed it and the thing worked. My next job is to tear the thing down and see how it works from the original design documents that gemini way back forever ago cobbled together.

oh, I've also created a really crap one shot javascript game and a chrome extension that monitors Amazon uk products.

Long and the short, I am really impresses so far with codex.

I've got way too much time on my hands!!
